name: Godawari Power and Ispat Ltd
title: Godawari Power and Ispat Ltd - 532734 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Captive iron ore and pellet ramp (new 2 Mt pellet plant at 70%, pellet capacity 4.7 Mt) drove Q4 EBITDA up 91% QoQ to INR 439 cr, but FY27 mining guidance was cut to 3.4 Mt usable ore from ~4.5-5 Mt.

summary.headline: GPIL FY26 consolidated EBITDA flat at INR 1,253 crore, but Q4 EBITDA rose 91% QoQ to INR 439 crore; FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 24-25%.
summary.overview: FY26 revenue and PAT were broadly stable, with consolidated PAT at INR 802 crore and EBITDA margin at 23%. Q4 FY26 revenue grew 41% QoQ and PAT reached INR 280 crore, driven by higher pellet volumes, a one-time carry-over pellet inventory gain (about INR 20 crore) and March mining uplift after environmental clearance for Ari Dongri. Consolidated PAT was below standalone because Ardent Steel was de-recognised as an associate after the stake sale. Management guided FY27 revenue above INR 6,000 crore and EBITDA margin of 24-25% at current market levels, while flagging price softness of about 10% in late April and early May.

segments.name: Iron ore mining (Ari Dongri / Boria Tibu)
segments.commentary: FY26 mining achieved 92% of target; FY26 mining was about 2.7-2.8 million tons versus 2.35-2.4 million tons in FY25. FY27 usable ore guidance is 3.4 million tons (4-4.25 million tons mined, including about 0.5 million tons from Boria Tibu).

segments.name: Pellets
segments.commentary: FY26 pellet output reached 95% of target. Pellet capacity rose from 2.7 to 4.7 million tons after the 2 million ton gas-based grate-kiln plant commissioned in December 2025; FY27 pellet guidance is 4 million tons, with about 3 million tons for merchant sales.

segments.name: Sponge iron
segments.commentary: Production exceeded 100% of plan in FY26. Capacity is being expanded from 0.59 to 0.65 million tons under a CTO received from CECB.

segments.name: Structural rolled products / RR Ispat
segments.commentary: Production exceeded 100% of plan in FY26 and rose sharply from Q4 after mill modifications finished at end-Q3; order book is about six months. Total FY27 rolled output is guided at about 3.7-3.75 lakh tons.

segments.name: Ferroalloys
segments.commentary: Production exceeded 100% of plan in FY26; no further figures given on the call.

segments.name: Galvanised / fabricated products and billets
segments.commentary: Billets reached 96% of target in FY26; sales volumes for galvanised fabricated products increased over the year.

segments.name: BESS (20 GWh project)
segments.commentary: Commissioning targeted March 2027, with long-term supply tie-ups with EVE Power (628 Ah LFP cells) and Shanghai Shenyi Roche. Phase-1 ramp is 5-6 GWh in FY28 (30-40%), about 12-14 GWh in FY29 and 17-18 GWh from FY30. Management guided a 7-8% margin, but said current margins are about 12-13%.

segments.name: CRM complex (0.7 million tons)
segments.commentary: Targeted commissioning March 2027; FY28 guidance is 50% utilisation, or 3-3.5 lakh tons. Management expects about 90% from FY29.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue to cross INR 6,000 crore, driven by the new pellet plant running at 80-90% of capacity.
FY27 EBITDA margin of 24-25% at current market levels; management said it expects to maintain about 25%.
Ari Dongri beneficiation plant (6 million tons) to be commissioned by Q3 FY27; full-scale mining of 6 million tons in FY28, with about 4.5 million tons of usable ore.
Capex guidance: about INR 1,500-2,000 crore in FY27, and about INR 3,000 crore each in FY28 and FY29, mainly for the steel plant.

Vision 2031 (per the presentation): steel, BESS (Phase-1) and CRM revenue are included. Management said PAT of about INR 3,000 crore implies a margin of about 10%, reflecting lower-margin BESS and CRM. Phase-2 BESS is excluded.

Steel plant: INR 7,000 crore 1 million ton integrated plant (blast furnace route, 50% pellet and 50% sinter feed); construction is expected to start in October 2026 and management expects EBITDA above 20% at full run-rate.
capex_capacity: Ari Dongri mines: EC and CTO received in February 2026 to expand from 2.35 to 6 million tons; phased ramp under way, full scale from FY28.
Pellet plant: 2 million ton natural gas-based plant commissioned in December 2025, running at about 70% in its first quarter; total capacity 4.7 million tons.
Captive solar: from 165 MW to 540 MW; 25 MW commissioned on 21 May 2026, with 100 MW more due by July 2026.
Waste heat recovery power capacity to reach 49 MW after a 7 MW addition; HB wire capacity to rise from 0.1 to 0.115 million tons.
EV fleet: 10 EV dumpers, 24 EV loaders and 15 EV excavators added in FY26. Plans for about 300-350 EV trucks, costing about INR 350 crore including charging infrastructure.
demand_pricing: Benchmark 62% Fe iron ore traded at $95-110/t recently; management expects prices above $100/t for the full year.
Pellet prices softened about 10% from late April/early May 2026 across the supply chain, citing war, summer heat and a weak steel finished-product market.
Domestic pellet price is about INR 9,500-10,000/t ex-plant; management said export pricing is now only about $10 apart from domestic and it may start exporting.
Q4 pellet realisations were held back because the EC delay forced production of 63% commercial-grade pellets instead of high-grade pellets, which earn a premium above INR 1,000/t.

Coal: Q1 FY27 average cost is about INR 12,000-13,000/t. Imported coal is up 15-20% from Q2 because of freight and currency; the company is about 100% on imported coal and may switch to domestic coal.
Mining-to-pellet conversion cost is about INR 2,000/t. Mining landed cost is about INR 3,000-3,200/t in FY27; transport cost is about INR 900/t, potentially rising to INR 1,150-1,200/t.

qa_highlights.question: Why has FY27 mining guidance (3.4 million tons) fallen versus the earlier 4.5-5 million tons?
qa_highlights.answer: 3.4 million tons is net usable ore after beneficiation. Mining will be about 4-4.25 million tons, including about 0.5 million tons from Boria Tibu, with about 0.8-1 million tons of ore bought from the market until post-monsoon.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the Q4 EBITDA jump?
qa_highlights.answer: Carry-over pellet inventory of about 89,000 tons sold in Q4, the new pellet plant ramp to 70% and about 2-2.5 lakh extra tons of mining in March after EC approval.

qa_highlights.question: What is the BESS margin and the lithium cost pass-through?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the margin was planned at 7-8% but is now 12-13%. Cell pricing with EVE is index-linked, so cost changes pass through to customers.

qa_highlights.question: Why is FY27 guidance for 24-25% EBITDA margin?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it reflects current market levels and the early stage of the year; pellet margins should widen from Q3 as high-grade mix rises after monsoon.

qa_highlights.question: Why did steel plant capex rise to INR 7,000 crore from the earlier INR 4,000 crore estimate?
qa_highlights.answer: Management apologised for an earlier estimation error. The increase reflects a coke oven plant (now needed after import curbs) and a value-added structural mill; EBITDA above 20% is expected at full capacity.

qa_highlights.question: What is the CRM and FY28 utilisation outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: The first line is expected by end-Q4 FY27 or early Q1 FY28. FY28 guidance is 50% utilisation (3-3.5 lakh tons), with about 90% from FY29.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company export pellets?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said exports may start soon if the domestic market stays weak; freight to China is about INR 3,000/t, and domestic prices are about INR 9,500-10,000/t ex-plant.

risks_watch: Pellet price softness (about 10% since late April) and weak steel demand, which could affect FY27 margin guidance.
Mining ramp-up: Ari Dongri beneficiation plant due Q3 FY27; ore purchases of about 0.8-1 million tons until post-monsoon raise procurement costs.
Diesel-linked transport cost (INR 900/t, potentially INR 1,150-1,200/t) and imported coal price rise of 15-20% from Q2 FY27.
BESS supply chain and competition: the first market entry is expected around September 2026, and components rely on tier-1 suppliers; the lithium price link is index-based.
Steel project funding: about INR 7,000 crore capex with heavy spend from FY28; management said it is self-funded for now, and consent to establish is still pending.
Consolidated versus standalone PAT gap from Ardent Steel de-recognition; INR 36-37 crore write-off of the Godawari Energy pre-operative cost.
Pellet and CRM margins on lower-margin BESS and CRM revenue expansion: management guided about 10% PAT margin in 2031.
key_quotes: Despite softer realization, GPIL delivered good set of numbers with revenues remaining steady and EBITDA and PAT margin strong at 23% and 15% respectively.
So, we were not able to produce the same volumes of high-grade pellets where we draw premium for more than INR 1,000.
We were wrong on the cost estimation. The current CAPEX given as INR 7,000 crores is very much on the practical side.
So, whenever we see domestic demand is on the, for example, today the domestic demand is on the weak side, you might hear where Godawari start exporting pellets from the next quarter.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident on FY26 delivery, the Ari Dongri mine expansion, pellet pricing recovery in Q3 and the BESS and CRM timelines, but was cautious on near-term pellet prices and was defensive on the steel plant capex jump. Answers on the 3.4 million ton mining guidance, the CRM and BESS ramp, and export intentions were given with conditional hedges such as "if" and "depends on".

growth.why: FY27 revenue guided above INR 6,000 crore, backed by the 2 MT pellet plant commissioned Dec 2025 (running ~70%, guided 80-90%) and a ~six-month rolled-products order book, but pellet prices fell ~10% in late April/early May and the Ari Dongri beneficiation plant and CRM/BESS capacity only arrive from Q3 FY27 onward.
